body:
### Short Description
Control Minecraft entirely from your terminal, scripts, or external applications via a powerful HTTP REST API.

---
![API Bridge banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f13df9e6dca9ca0ec376aaba5629f1dd1a2bbf8d_0.webp)
---

### Body / Full Description

**API Bridge** is a powerful Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that exposes an internal HTTP REST API. It allows you to programmatically control almost every aspect of the game—from client UI interactions to player movements, world settings, and block manipulation—directly from your terminal, Python scripts, or Node.js applications without ever touching your keyboard or mouse!

**Key Features**
*   **Complete Client Automation:** Simulate keyboard inputs (WASD, sprint, jump) and UI interactions (e.g., automatically click the "Singleplayer" button).
*   **Player & World Control:** Teleport, change look direction (pitch/yaw), swing hands, change the time of day, and toggle weather conditions.
*   **Inventory & Block Manipulation:** Place or break blocks anywhere, drop items, change selected hotbar slots, and manage your inventory on the fly.
*   **Scripting & Macros System:** Send a list of commands to execute sequentially for advanced automation (like building an auto-mining bot).
*   **Language Agnostic:** If it can send an HTTP request, it can control Minecraft! Easily integrate with `curl`, Python, JavaScript, or any language you prefer.

Whether you want to build automated bots, test game mechanics, or create custom external controllers, MC API Mod provides the ultimate programmatic interface for Minecraft.
